<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Cancel an ASN"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/asns/{asnNumber}/cancel"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Cancels a `Registered` ASN and publishes `ASNCancelled`. An ASN that is
already being received is 409 `asn-in-progress`; a `Closed` or
`Cancelled` one is 409 `asn-terminal`. The body and its `reason` are
optional.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>

</Heading>
